$comment: Made-up illnesses you get from running a need down to 0 again and again (D-080): from_zero names the need and how many times it must hit 0 (needs_at_zero.json counts each time) within within_days game days. The count starts again once the illness comes on. They behave like any condition in conditions.json: they wear on you every hour, last hours (0 = until treated) and are cured by the care named in treated_by.

conditions.name: Lantern Fatigue
conditions.onset: You've run yourself empty one time too many: you have Lantern Fatigue. Your energy drains faster for days, or until a clinic treats it.

conditions.name: Hollow Gut
conditions.onset: Starving yourself has caught up with you: you have Hollow Gut. You get hungry faster and it wears on your health until a clinic treats it.

conditions.name: Greyheart
conditions.onset: Collapsing again has left its mark: you have Greyheart. Your health and energy keep slipping until a doctor treats it.

conditions.name: Tidewater Bladder
conditions.onset: Too many accidents: you have Tidewater Bladder. You need the bathroom far more often until a clinic treats it.

conditions.name: Mire Rash
conditions.onset: Going unwashed has given you Mire Rash: it itches, it shows, and it lasts days unless a clinic treats it.

conditions.name: Echo Sickness
conditions.onset: Being alone this long has given you Echo Sickness: the quiet follows you around. Therapy treats it.

conditions.name: the Grey Spell
conditions.onset: All work and no play: the Grey Spell has settled on you. Nothing feels fun for days, unless therapy lifts it.

conditions.name: Knotback
conditions.onset: Your body has knotted up from too long without comfort: you have Knotback. It aches for days unless a clinic treats it.
